content: यमक {%a.%} [यम-स्वार्थे क] .²1 Twin-born, twin. .²2 Two-fold, double. .{@-कः@} .²1 A restraint, check. .²2 A twin; one of a pair, a fellow. .²3 A great moral or religious duty; see यम (4). .{@-कम्@} .²1 A double bandage. .²2 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Repetition in the same stanza (in any part of it) of words or syllables similar in sound, but different in meaning, a kind of rhyme, (of which various kinds are enumerated; see <ls>Kāv. 3. 2-52</ls>); सभा नलश्रीयमकैर्यमाद्यैर्नलं विनाभूद् धृतदिव्यरत्नैः <ls>N. 10. 24</ls>; आवृत्तिं वर्णसंघातगोचरां यमकं विदुः <ls>Kāv. 1. 61</ls>, <ls n="Kāv.">3. 1</ls>; <ls>S.
